validation_scope: All 8 newly matching src/worldmap/scene functions are locally verified against A2DE with equal function sizes, complete relocation-normalized ARM instructions, and equal explicit relocation offsets/types/symbol names/addends. commit_message:
decomp: recover 8 more worldmap scene helpers (A2DE 4.423224%)

Recover two dialog render/dispatch helpers, one dialog-state setup helper,
three scene cleanup/post-update helpers, and two completion/state helpers
in src/worldmap/scene.

Add 616 matching code bytes and 8 matching functions over 9eaa599.
Totals: 127,232 / 2,876,454 code bytes and 1,514 / 15,667 functions.
Matching data remains 4,276 / 851,344 and no previous match is lost.
The worldmap scene unit reaches 2,696 / 15,256 matching code bytes and
49 / 69 matching functions.

All eight pass full local ARM instruction and explicit relocation
offset/type/name/addend comparison against A2DE. Fuzzy-only candidate
functions remain excluded. Public CI recompiles the same source and
reproduces the batch fingerprint before publishing.
No ROM or extracted original game binaries are included.
